questions.question:
Examine the four jumbled sentences. Out of the given options, pick the one that gives their correct order.

A. Next, keep tapping the pot on all sides and at the bottom until the plant loosens.

B. Finally, slide the plant gently and remove the old potting mix on a newspaper.

C. The first thing to do when repotting is to remove the plant from the current pot.

D. Begin by holding the plant gently, and turning the pot sideways.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'CDAB'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In order to **arrange **such types of **jumbled sentences** in the correct sequence, we need to **follow **some **basic rules**.
 
• This **type of question** comes under the **chronological group category**.
 
• Just we need to **follow **the **words **like **first, second, next, last, finally, etc.**
 
• If we read the sentences, we get to know the **method of re-potting has been explained.**
 
• **Option C **must be the **first line **as it's already mentioned in the sentence. (The first thing to do)
 
• **Option D** will be the **second**, as it's explaining **how to start the process**. (Begin by holding)
 
• **Option A **is the **third **sentence, as it's mentioned **what to do next**. (Next, keep tapping)
 
• **Option B **is the **last **one, as the word '**finally**' clearly states the **last step**. (Finally, slide the plant gently).
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sometimes in the '**chronological group category**' sentence would be there **with the date or year** when a particular **event took place.**
 
• For example:
 
 
• In **1950**, he was born. In **1980 **wrote a novel. In **2010**, he died.

questions.question:

• The car was driven very carefully on the hilly terrain.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **option 2.**

questions.question:
Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.

“I love Bollywood music,” Deepu said to Reena.

options.text: Deepu had told Reena that he loved Bollywood music.
Deepu will say to Reena that he loved Bollywood music.
Deepu told Reena that he loved Bollywood music.
Deepu says to Reena that he loves Bollywood music.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'Deepu told Reena that he loved Bollywood music.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **sentence **is in the **past tense.**
 
• To **convert **from **direct into indirect speech**, we need to make some **required changes.**
 
 
• First of all, '**said to**' will be changed into '**told**'.
 
• Second, **remove inverted commas and use 'that'.**
 
• Based on the subject and object of reporting speech, bring some **changes in the reported speech noun.** *(Deepu is the one who loved music, so change 'I' into 'he'.)*
 
• Make required **changes in the verb based on the tense of** 'reporting speech'. ('**Said to**' represents **past indefinite tense **so the verb '**love**' will be changed into '**loved**'.)
 
 
 
• Now the **indirect speech would be**:
 
 
• Deepu told Reena that he loved Bollywood music.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

questions.question: Ravi can row a boat in still water at the speed of 14 km/h. If a river is flowing at the sped of 2 km/h and Ravi takes 3 hours to cover a certain distance upstream, then how much time will he take to cover the same distance downstream?
questions.solution:
Given:

Speed of the boat = 14kmph 

Flow of the river = 2 kmph

Ravi takes 3 hours to cover a certain distance upstream

Concept used:

Distance = Time × Speed

While going upstream, the speed of a boat and the flow of the river get added to calculate the effective speed. On the other hand, while going downstream, to take the effective speed, the difference between the speed of the boat and the flow of the river is considered. 

Calculation:

Effective speed during the upstream journey = (14 - 2) kmph = 12kmph

Distance covered = 12 × 3 = 36 hours

Effective speed during the downstream journey = (14 + 2) kmph = 16kmph

So, time taken by Ravi to cover 36 km downstream = 36 ÷ 16 = 2.25 hours = 2 hours 15 minutes

**∴ Ravi will take 2 hours 15 minutes to cover the same distance downstream.**

questions.question: D, E and F are the feet of the perpendiculars from the vertices A, B and C, respectively, of a triangle ABC. If angle BED and angle BFE (in degrees) are 24 and 110, respectively, what is the measure (in degrees) of angle EBF?

Given: 

D, E, and F are the feet of the perpendiculars from the vertices A, B, and C, respectively, of a triangle ABC.

∠BED and ∠BFE (in degrees) are 24 and 110

Concept used:

The angle subtended by a chord of a circle at its centre is equal to the angle subtended by the corresponding (minor) arc at the centre.

The sum of all angles in a triangle is always 180°

Calculation:

**Here we have to do construction:**

Draw a circle of diameter AB which passes through D as ∠ADB = 90° 

Draw another circle of diameter BC which passes through E as ∠BEC = 90° 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31eb89591352567b2434f0be26f65e87c56163158579f428dea0c14319c53bcd.png]

Now, taking AB as the diameter, we draw a circle.

Here, ∠AEB is a subtended angle on circumference from the diameter which is 90°.

Now, considering BD a chord, ∠BED = ∠BAD = 24°

So, in ΔABD,

∠BAD + ∠ADB + ∠ABD = 180°

⇒ 24° + 90° + ∠ABE + ∠EBD = 180°

⇒ 24° + 90° + ∠ABE + 20° = 180°

⇒ ∠ABE = 46°

⇒ ∠EBF = 46°

**∴ The measure of ∠EBF is 46°.**

• The speaker of the Lok Sabha/legislative assembly vacates the office immediately before the first meeting of the newly elected house.

• The first meeting after the election when the Speaker and the Deputy Speaker are selected by members of the Parliament is held under the pro tem Speaker.
 
• The pro tem Speaker also administers the oath of office to the newly elected MPs.
 
• On the election of a new Speaker, the office of the pro tem speaker ceases to exist.
 
• The **Vice President** holds office for **five years**. The Vice President can be re-elected any number of times. However, the office may be terminated earlier by death, resignation, or removal. The Constitution does not provide a mechanism of succession to the office of Vice President in the event of an extraordinary vacancy, apart from re-election. However, the Deputy Chairman of the Rajya Sabha can perform the Vice President's duties as the Chairman of the Rajya Sabha in such an event.

• The National Education Policy 2020 has set the target to increase public investment in the education sector to reach** 6 percent of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) **at the earliest.
 
• After almost three decades, the government is ready to transform the country's education system by making some impactful suggestions.
 
• While the National Education Policy 2020 (NEP 2020) aims at making India a global knowledge superpower by providing high-quality education to all.
 
• The policy focuses on almost **doubling **the **Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER)** in higher education, including vocational education, from **26.3 percent** to **50 percent by 2035.**

• As a broad measure of overall domestic production, it functions as a comprehensive scorecard of a given country's economic health.
